title: Wide scan projection index map
scope: table scan projection index planning for wide schemas

summary: Added projection_indices_for_scan to centralize case-insensitive projection index resolution.
Kept the existing linear lookup path for small projection/schema combinations.
Added a HashMap-backed schema index path for wider scans to avoid repeated schema-column walks.
Added a wide-table projection regression that corrupts an unused tail column and proves the scan still performs partial decode of only projected columns.

next_task_signals: Continue scanning database-core execution hot paths for narrow, testable performance iterations.
